Note 1: Description of Business and Summary of Significant Accounting Policies
Aldervane Holdings, Inc. is a leading provider of commerce, cloud computing, and digital entertainment services.
During the fiscal year ended December 31, 2024, our global workforce expanded to approximately 1,525,000 full-time and part-time employees.
Cash and cash equivalents totaled $73,200 million at December 31, 2024, compared with $60,100 million at December 31, 2023.
Total assets reached $520,400 million at December 31, 2024, an increase from $462,700 million at the prior year end.
Capital expenditures for the year ended December 31, 2024 were $53,200 million, primarily reflecting investments in technology infrastructure.

Note 2: Segment Reporting
We organize our operations into three reportable segments: North America, International, and AWS Cloud.
Information concerning our segment revenues and operating income is summarized below.
For the year ended December 31, 2024, North America net sales were $387,400 million, compared to $352,800 million in 2023.
North America operating income was $24,800 million in 2024, compared to $14,900 million in 2023.
International net sales for the year ended December 31, 2024 were $143,200 million, compared to $131,200 million in 2023.
International operating income for 2024 was $2,800 million, representing a turnaround from an operating loss of ($2,700) million in 2023.
AWS Cloud net sales were $107,359 million in 2024, an increase of 19% over sales of $90,757 million in 2023.
AWS Cloud operating income was $32,859 million in 2024, representing an operating margin of 30.6%.

Note 3: Long-Term Debt and Leases
As of December 31, 2024, we had $58,300 million of total long-term debt outstanding, with maturities ranging from 2025 to 2062.
Finance lease liabilities totaled $16,400 million as of December 31, 2024, and operating lease liabilities totaled $78,500 million.
The weighted-average remaining lease term for operating leases was 8.4 years as of December 31, 2024.
Rental expense under operating leases was $11,200 million in 2024, $10,100 million in 2023, and $8,900 million in 2022.
We anticipate future lease commitments of $12,400 million in 2025, $11,800 million in 2026, and $35,600 million thereafter.
